english.title: Fail to report arrival of vessel within 24 hours of arrival to the Harbour Master
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the master of a vessel liable to rates, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), failed to report the arrival of the vessel to the harbour master within 24 hours after its arrival within the limits of the harbour, dock, or pier at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35 of the Harbours, Docks and Piers Clauses Act 1847.
